what: Clicking a same-origin link reveals the new page as if burning outward from the click point — the screen is split into an 8px cell field, each cell gets a threshold of ”distance from the click (in screen-height units) + slow wave noise × .34 + per-cell grain × .06”, and as a 1.1s sine.inOut progress passes the threshold, cells open onto the new screen (clip-path path of the View Transition new view). The .035 band just ahead of progress is painted in ember colors (light accent in front, accent behind) so the burning edge bleeds, and passed cells cool and fade from the accent color over a .12 tail. Without View Transition or on file://, the old page is burned over in the background color with the same field (.66s power2.inOut) and the new page burns it away again (.85s)

options.dur: Turn duration (s), default 1.1 — shorten it for screens flipped often
options.spray · warp: Cell grain scatter · slow wave noise strength (in screen-height units), default .06 · .34 (original U) — if both are 0 it spreads as a round circle
options.tail: Length of the tail where a passed cell cools down (in screen-height units), default .12
options.cover · uncover: Cover and uncover length on the alternate path (sec), default .66 · .85
options.[data-fx-part=plain]: This link (or links inside it) is not routed through the transition and is simply skipped
options.fx:burn-end: Event the element fires when fully burned on a new page

note: The original draws the cell-field threshold and ember band with WebGL shaders (through·grain programs) and runs in the same document as a single-page app. The part draws the same cell field, length and curve on a 2D canvas, on the new-document side of a cross-document View Transition. On large screens with many cells the path gets longer, so raising cell makes it lighter

from.where: All pages body, original burn transition (cell 8px · 1.1s sine.inOut · band .035 · U warp .34 · spray .06 · tail .12 · progress -spray-.02 → far corner+.75warp+spray+.04 · fallback grain cover .66 power2.inOut · walk .85 power1.inOut)
